data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 七里滨的潮声花嫁
data.description: 【七里滨海边小礼堂·黄昏】翔子穿着柔和的白色婚纱站在敞开的礼堂门口，黑发被海风吹过肩头；她双手捧着白色小花，侧头听了一会潮声，再向镜头露出让人安心的温柔笑容。
data.action: 海边礼堂门口听潮声后捧花转身，露出让人安心的温柔笑
data.lighting: peach sunset and reflected ocean light
data.mood: 在海潮旁兑现的温柔承诺
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara listens to the waves at the open seaside chapel doorway, then turns with a reassuring smile and white coastal flowers held close to her heart. Her soft white bridal dress carries a sea-blue sash beneath a short veil. In the vertical medium-full view, the doorway frames the shore beyond. Peach sunset colors the veil's edge, while reflected ocean light lifts the folds facing the water.
